card.name: Boxed warning headings in capitals
card.fires_on: Words inside all-caps boxed warning headings, especially the ending of HEPATOTOXICITY and words like USE or DO in warning lines. Also weakly on the start of error messages like Invalid.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The final piece of HEPATOTOXICITY in an all-caps WARNING title.

modes.label: Warning command lines
modes.description: Words in capitalized route or application warnings such as NOT FOR INTRAVENOUS USE.

modes.label: Error message start
modes.description: The first word of a quoted computer error message or a stray word like recognized.

card.plain: It lights up in the capitalized headline of a boxed warning, most often at the end of HEPATOTOXICITY.
